SELECT fn_get_dynamic_seq('utb_conflict_mst')
INSERT INTO utb_conflict_mst ( conflict_seq, office_seq, app_seq, litigation_case_no, court_category_code, case_title_ko, case_category_code, status, petitioner_type, petitioner_memo, respondent_type, respondent_memo, pre_exam_result, final_result, decision_content, appeal_content, agent_category_code, case_type_code, abandon_yn, abandon_content, dept_name, etc_yn, asset_no, agent_ref, introducer, respondent_name, case_classification, note, foreign_agent, client, del_yn, create_user, create_at ) VALUES ( #{conflictSeq}, #{officeSeq}, #{appSeq}, #{litigationCaseNo}, #{courtCategoryCode}, #{caseTitleKo}, #{appClassificationCode}, #{status}, #{petitionerType}, #{petitionerMemo}, #{respondentType}, #{respondentMemo}, #{preExamResult}, #{finalResult}, #{decisionContent}, #{appealContent}, #{agentCategoryCode}, #{caseTypeCode}, #{abandonYn}, #{abandonContent}, #{deptName}, #{etcYn}, #{ourRef}, #{yourRef}, #{introducer}, #{respondent}, CASE WHEN #{etcYn} = 'N' THEN '40' WHEN #{etcYn} = 'Y' THEN '50' ELSE '00' END, #{note}, #{foreignAgent}, #{client}, 'N', #{createUser}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE utb_conflict_mst SET app_seq = #{appSeq}, litigation_case_no = #{litigationCaseNo}, court_category_code = #{courtCategoryCode}, case_title_ko = #{caseTitleKo}, case_category_code = #{appClassificationCode}, status = #{status}, petitioner_type = #{petitionerType}, petitioner_memo = #{petitionerMemo}, respondent_type = #{respondentType}, respondent_memo = #{respondentMemo}, pre_exam_result = #{preExamResult}, final_result = #{finalResult}, decision_content = #{decisionContent}, appeal_content = #{appealContent}, agent_category_code = #{agentCategoryCode}, case_type_code = #{caseTypeCode}, abandon_yn = #{abandonYn}, abandon_content = #{abandonContent}, dept_name = #{deptName}, etc_yn = #{etcYn}, asset_no = #{ourRef}, agent_ref = #{yourRef}, introducer = #{introducer}, respondent_name = #{respondent}, note = #{note}, foreign_agent = #{foreignAgent}, client = #{client}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_at = NOW() WHERE conflict_seq = #{conflictSeq} AND office_seq = #{officeSeq}
mapper.select:
SELECT /* 출원 마스터 정보 조인 */ mst.asset_no as ourRef, mst.agent_ref as yourRef, fn_get_participant_name(mst.office_seq, mst.conflict_seq, 'clientName') AS clientName, app.domestic_reg_no as domesticRegNo,
/* 분쟁 마스터 정보 */ mst.conflict_seq, mst.office_seq, mst.app_seq, mst.litigation_case_no as caseNo, mst.court_category_code, fn_get_cd_nm('COURT_TYPE', mst.court_category_code) AS courtCategoryCodeName, c.case_category_code, fn_get_cd_nm('NAT_IO_DIV', c.case_category_code) AS case_category_code_name, mst.case_type_code, fn_get_cd_nm('CASE_TYPE_TRIAL', mst.case_type_code) AS caseTypeCodeName, mst.agent_category_code, fn_get_cd_nm('AGENT_TYPE', mst.agent_category_code) AS agentCategoryCodeName, mst.status, fn_get_cd_nm('STATUS', status) AS statusCodeName, mst.petitioner_type, mst.petitioner_memo, mst.respondent_type, mst.respondent_memo, mst.pre_exam_result, mst.final_result, mst.decision_content, mst.appeal_content, mst.abandon_yn as isAbandoned, mst.abandon_content, mst.note, mst.case_title_ko, mst.del_yn, mst.create_user, mst.create_at, mst.update_user, mst.update_at FROM utb_conflict_mst mst LEFT JOIN utb_app_mst app ON mst.app_seq = app.app_seq AND mst.office_seq = app.office_seq WHERE mst.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND mst.etc_yn = #{etcYn} AND mst.del_yn = 'N' AND (app.del_yn = 'N' OR app.del_yn IS NULL) ORDER BY mst.create_at DESC

SELECT fn_get_dynamic_seq('utb_conflict_result')
INSERT INTO utb_conflict_result ( conflict_result_seq, conflict_seq, office_seq, judgment_content, judgment_case_no, judgment_search_url, judgment_category_code, note, create_user, create_at, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{conflictResultSeq}, #{conflictSeq}, #{officeSeq}, #{judgmentContent}, #{judgmentCaseNo}, #{judgmentSearchUrl}, #{judgmentCategoryCode}, #{note}, #{createUser}, NOW(), 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE utb_app_mst SET right_category = #{rightTypeCode}, retain_seq = #{clientRef}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_at = NOW() WHERE office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND app_seq = #{appSeq} AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT res.conflict_seq AS conflictSeq, res.judgment_case_no AS judgmentCaseNo, res.judgment_content AS judgmentContent, res.judgment_search_url AS judgmentSearchUrl, /* CodeInfo 구성을 위한 코드와 명칭 */ res.judgment_category_code AS judgmentCategoryCode, fn_get_cd_nm('JUDG_CAT', res.judgment_category_code) AS judgmentCategoryName, res.note AS note, /* 날짜 포맷팅 */ fn_get_duedate_str(res.office_seq, res.conflict_result_seq, 'resultDecisionDate') AS resultDecisionDate FROM utb_conflict_result res WHERE res.conflict_seq = #{conflictSeq} AND res.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND res.del_yn = 'N'

SELECT mst.conflict_seq, mst.office_seq, mst.conflict_result_seq, mst.judgment_content, mst.judgment_search_url, mst.note FROM utb_conflict_mst mst WHERE mst.conflict_seq = #{conflictSeq} AND mst.office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND mst.del_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE utb_file_mapp SET del_yn = 'Y', update_user = #{updateUser}, update_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE office_seq = #{officeSeq} AND file_seq = #{fileSeq} AND del_yn = 'N'
